version: 1
suite:
  id: backtesting
  name: Pine strategy backtest end to end
  description: Runs a tiny Pine SMA-cross strategy on an explicit chart, polls to a terminal status, checks metrics are finite and internally consistent, pages trades and equity, then removes and deletes only the AI TEST run.
  activeHistoryPolicy: |
    Before each creating test, inspect the history setup response (all active runs, not libraryList).
    There are at most three active slots. If data.runs has three entries, reclaim a slot ONLY
    from a stopped run whose ID this invocation recorded after a successful creation and whose
    recorded name starts with AI TEST. A matching prefix alone is never proof of ownership.
    Re-read that run with backtesting.get, then backtesting.delete with its current revision
    and a fresh ai-test retry key; verify absence with backtesting.list before continuing.
    Never cancel or delete pre-existing user runs, even AI TEST residue from other invocations.
    If no owned stopped run is available, SKIP with reason SIMULATION_HISTORY_FULL:
    all three active slots are occupied by unowned or running runs; export/save then explicitly
    Delete a stopped run in History to free a slot. Do not send backtesting.run in this case.
    A race may still return SIMULATION_HISTORY_FULL from run; use the same safe ownership
    check or SKIP with that reason, never blind retry. Teardown skips uncaptured run IDs.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentIndicators"]
    signIn: false
  defaults:
    symbol: NSE:TCS-EQ
    interval: 1D
    strategy: |
      //@version=5
      strategy("AI TEST SMA cross", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000)
      fastLen = input.int(10, "Fast", minval=2)
      slowLen = input.int(30, "Slow", minval=3)
      fast = ta.sma(close, fastLen)
      slow = ta.sma(close, slowLen)
      if ta.crossover(fast, slow)
          strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
      if ta.crossunder(fast, slow)
          strategy.close("Long")

tests:
  - id: backtesting.capabilities
    name: Capabilities describe simulation-only execution
    category: contract
    tags: ["backtesting"]
    execute:
      type: backtesting.capabilities
      params: {}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.liveBrokerOrders
          equals: false
        - path: data.modes
          contains: "backtest"

  - id: backtesting.presets-readable
    name: Preset and run lists are pageable without mutation
    category: contract
    tags: ["backtesting"]
    setup:
      - id: presets
        type: backtesting.presetList
        params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 5}
    execute:
      type: backtesting.list
      params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 5}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.runs
          type: array

  - id: backtesting.pine-run
    name: Pine strategy run completes with sane metrics
    category: workflow
    tags: ["backtesting", "pine", "slow"]
    setup:
      - id: history
        type: backtesting.list
        params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 5}
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{suite.defaults.symbol}}", "feed": "default", "interval": "{{suite.defaults.interval}}"}
      - id: chartReady
        kind: poll
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.history.state
          equals: ready
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
      - id: compile
        type: indicators.validate
        params: {"source": "{{suite.defaults.strategy}}"}
      - id: run
        type: backtesting.run
        params: {"language": "pine", "source": "{{suite.defaults.strategy}}", "bars": 1000, "range": null, "versionSuffix": "AI TEST {{run.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-bt-run"
      - id: done
        kind: poll
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "trades", "limit": 1}
        until:
          path: data.status
          oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"]
        intervalMs: 2000
        timeoutMs: 180000
      - id: show
        type: backtesting.show
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-bt-show"
    execute:
      type: backtesting.get
      params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "trades", "offset": 0, "limit": 20}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.status
          equals: completed
        - path: data.language
          equals: pine
        - path: data.totalBars
          gte: 2
        - path: data.metrics.equity
          finite: true
        - path: data.metrics.netPnl
          finite: true
        - path: data.metrics.closedLegs
          gte: 0
        - path: data.metrics.maxDrawdown
          gte: 0
        - path: data.metrics.maxDrawdownPct
          gte: 0
          lte: 100
        - path: data.metrics.fees
          gte: 0
        - path: data.total
          equals: "{{steps.done.data.metrics.closedLegs}}"
        - path: data.rows
          type: array
      state:
        - label: equity curve is pageable and finite
          type: backtesting.get
          params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "equity", "offset": 0, "limit": 5}
          assertions:
            - path: data.section
              equals: equity
            - path: data.total
              gte: 1
    teardown:
      - id: detach
        type: backtesting.removeFromChart
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-bt-detach"
      - id: latest
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
      - id: delete
        type: backtesting.delete
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.latest.data.revision}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-bt-delete"
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: backtesting.python-config-rejected-for-pine
    name: Generic Python config is rejected for a Pine run
    category: contract
    tags: ["backtesting", "pine", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: backtesting.run
      params: {"language": "pine", "source": "{{suite.defaults.strategy}}", "config": {"initialCapital": 5000}, "bars": 200}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-bt-badconfig"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

  - id: backtesting.unknown-run
    name: Reading an unknown run ID fails explicitly
    category: contract
    tags: ["backtesting", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: backtesting.get
      params: {"runId": "sim-ai-test-does-not-exist"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

version: 1
suite:
  id: charts
  name: Chart navigation, view and drawings
  description: Opens an explicit symbol/interval, changes the native view, creates and removes one AI TEST drawing, and captures chart evidence.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentWrites"]
    signIn: false
  defaults:
    symbol: NSE:TCS-EQ
    feed: default
    interval: 1D

tests:
  - id: charts.open-symbol
    name: chart.open navigates to an explicit symbol, feed and interval
    category: state
    tags: ["charts", "navigation"]
    setup:
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: chart.open
      params: {"symbol": "{{suite.defaults.symbol}}", "feed": "{{suite.defaults.feed}}", "interval": "{{suite.defaults.interval}}"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      state:
        - label: chart reaches ready with the requested context
          kind: poll
          type: chart.getState
          params: {}
          until:
            path: data.history.state
            equals: ready
          intervalMs: 1000
          timeoutMs: 30000
          assertions:
            - path: data.available
              equals: true
            - path: data.ready
              equals: true
            - path: data.symbol
              equals: "{{suite.defaults.symbol}}"
            - path: data.interval
              equals: "{{suite.defaults.interval}}"
            - path: data.history.state
              equals: ready
    teardown:
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: charts.snapshot
    name: chart.snapshot returns bounded rows with explicit provenance labels
    category: contract
    tags: ["charts", "data"]
    execute:
      type: chart.snapshot
      params: {"bars": 5}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.timeUnit
          equals: unix_seconds
        - path: data.freshness
          equals: not_verified
        - path: data.returnedRows
          gte: 1
          lte: 5
        - path: data.rows
          minLength: 1

  - id: charts.set-view
    name: chart.setView applies a preset range and percent price scale
    category: state
    tags: ["charts", "view"]
    setup:
      - id: before
        type: chart.viewState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: chart.setView
      params: {"visibleRange": {"preset": "6m"}, "priceScale": {"mode": "percent"}}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-view-set"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      state:
        - label: view reflects percent scale
          type: chart.viewState
          params: {}
          assertions:
            - path: status
              equals: ok
    teardown:
      - id: restoreScale
        type: chart.setView
        params: {"priceScale": {"mode": "normal", "autoScale": true}}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-view-restore"

  - id: charts.drawing-lifecycle
    name: Create, list and remove one horizontal line drawing
    category: state
    tags: ["charts", "drawings"]
    setup:
      - id: snap
        type: chart.snapshot
        params: {"bars": 1}
    execute:
      type: drawings.create
      params: {"tool": "horizontal_line", "points": [{"time": "{{steps.snap.data.rows.0.0}}", "price": "{{steps.snap.data.rows.0.4}}"}], "locked": false}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-draw-hline"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.id
          exists: true
        - path: data.tool
          equals: horizontal_line
      state:
        - label: drawing is listed
          type: drawings.list
          params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 100}
          assertions:
            - path: data.items
              contains: {"id": "{{steps.execute.data.id}}"}
    teardown:
      - id: removeDrawing
        type: drawings.update
        params: {"ids": ["{{steps.execute.data.id}}"], "remove": true}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-draw-remove"
      - id: verifyRemoved
        type: drawings.list
        params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 100}

  - id: charts.text-drawing-visual
    name: A text drawing renders legibly on the chart
    category: visual
    tags: ["charts", "drawings", "visual"]
    setup:
      - id: snap
        type: chart.snapshot
        params: {"bars": 1}
    execute:
      type: drawings.create
      params: {"tool": "text", "points": [{"time": "{{steps.snap.data.rows.0.0}}", "price": "{{steps.snap.data.rows.0.4}}"}], "text": "AI TEST label"}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-draw-text"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      visual:
        screenshot: charts-text-drawing
        criteria:
          - The text "AI TEST label" is visible on the chart near the latest candle.
          - The label does not cover the price scale or toolbar.
    teardown:
      - id: removeText
        type: drawings.update
        params: {"ids": ["{{steps.execute.data.id}}"], "remove": true}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-draw-text-remove"

  - id: charts.invalid-drawing
    name: A drawing with the wrong point count is rejected without side effects
    category: contract
    tags: ["charts", "drawings", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: drawings.create
      params: {"tool": "trend_line", "points": [{"time": 1717200000, "price": 100}]}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-draw-invalid"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

  - id: charts.native-screenshot
    name: chart.action screenshot returns a bounded PNG
    category: visual
    tags: ["charts", "visual"]
    execute:
      type: chart.action
      params: {"action": "screenshot"}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-chart-shot"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      visual:
        screenshot: charts-native
        criteria:
          - The image shows NSE:TCS-EQ daily candles with a readable price axis and time axis.
          - No loading spinner, empty pane or error overlay is visible.

files.tl-testing/suites/indicators.yaml:
version: 1
suite:
  id: indicators
  name: TLScript-Pine Studio validate, apply and remove
  description: Compiles a tiny Pine indicator, rejects broken and strategy source on the indicator surface, applies headlessly to the active chart, verifies it, and removes exactly that instance. Never saves to the user's source library.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentIndicators"]
    signIn: false
  defaults:
    source: |
      //@version=5
      indicator("AI TEST EMA", overlay=true)
      length = input.int(9, "Length", minval=2, maxval=200)
      plot(ta.ema(close, length), "AI TEST EMA", color=color.orange)

tests:
  - id: indicators.validate-ok
    name: Valid Pine compiles with inputs and compile-only labels
    category: contract
    tags: ["indicators", "pine"]
    execute:
      type: indicators.validate
      params: {"source": "{{suite.defaults.source}}", "profile": true}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.valid
          equals: true
        - path: data.kind
          equals: indicator
        - path: data.title
          equals: AI TEST EMA
        - path: data.inputs
          contains: {"id": "length"}
        - path: data.calculationCorrectness
          equals: not-verified

  - id: indicators.validate-broken
    name: Broken Pine returns status ok with valid:false and located diagnostics
    category: contract
    tags: ["indicators", "pine", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: indicators.validate
      params: {"source": "//@version=5\nindicator(\"AI TEST broken\")\nplot(ta.ema(close, )\n"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.valid
          equals: false
        - path: data.diagnostics
          minLength: 1

  - id: indicators.strategy-on-indicator-surface
    name: Strategy source is not applied as an indicator
    category: contract
    tags: ["indicators", "pine", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: indicators.apply
      params: {"source": "//@version=5\nstrategy(\"AI TEST strat\", overlay=true)\nif ta.crossover(ta.sma(close, 5), ta.sma(close, 20))\n    strategy.entry(\"L\", strategy.long)\n", "showInStudio": false}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-ind-strategy-reject"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

  - id: indicators.apply-remove
    name: Apply headlessly, verify the instance, then remove exactly it
    category: state
    tags: ["indicators", "pine", "chart-write"]
    setup:
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "NSE:TCS-EQ", "feed": "default", "interval": "1D"}
      - id: ready
        kind: poll
        type: indicators.applied
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.chart.ready
          equals: true
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
    execute:
      type: indicators.apply
      params: {"source": "{{suite.defaults.source}}", "inputs": {"length": 12}, "showInStudio": false}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-ind-apply"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.instanceId
          exists: true
        - path: data.title
          equals: AI TEST EMA
      state:
        - label: applied list contains the instance
          type: indicators.applied
          params: {}
          assertions:
            - path: data.indicators
              contains: {"instanceId": "{{steps.execute.data.instanceId}}"}
    teardown:
      - id: remove
        type: indicators.remove
        params: {"instanceId": "{{steps.execute.data.instanceId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-ind-remove"
      - id: afterRemove
        type: indicators.applied
        params: {}
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: indicators.applied-visual
    name: Applied EMA renders as an orange overlay line
    category: visual
    tags: ["indicators", "visual", "chart-write"]
    execute:
      type: indicators.apply
      params: {"source": "{{suite.defaults.source}}", "showInStudio": false}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-ind-visual"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      visual:
        screenshot: indicators-ema-overlay
        criteria:
          - An orange EMA line is drawn over the candles and follows price.
          - The legend shows the TL Pine badge and the "AI TEST EMA" title (Pine inputs live in the native settings dialog, not the legend).
          - No compile or runtime error badge is visible on the study.
    teardown:
      - id: removeVisual
        type: indicators.remove
        params: {"instanceId": "{{steps.execute.data.instanceId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-ind-visual-remove"

files.tl-testing/suites/llm-subjective.yaml:
version: 1
suite:
  id: llm-subjective
  name: LLM-judged product quality
  description: Subjective checks an AI judge scores against a rubric - chart readability, backtest evidence clarity and error-message usefulness. Each criterion is PASS/FAIL with one sentence of evidence; any FAIL fails the test.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentWrites", "allowAgentIndicators"]
    signIn: false

tests:
  - id: llm.chart-readability
    name: A freshly opened chart is readable and correctly labelled
    category: visual
    tags: ["llm", "visual", "charts"]
    judge: llm
    steps:
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "NSE:HDFCBANK-EQ", "feed": "default", "interval": "1D"}
      - id: ready
        kind: poll
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.history.state
          equals: ready
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
      - id: shot
        kind: screenshot
        source: window
    criteria:
      - The header/legend shows HDFCBANK and the daily interval, matching the requested context.
      - Candles fill the pane without large unexplained gaps or a flat line.
      - Price and time axes are legible and not overlapping other UI.
      - Nothing on screen claims live data freshness that was not verified.
    teardown:
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: llm.backtest-explainability
    name: Backtest evidence would let a trader explain the result
    category: workflow
    tags: ["llm", "backtesting", "slow"]
    judge: llm
    steps:
      - id: run
        type: backtesting.run
        params: {"language": "pine", "source": "//@version=5\nstrategy(\"AI TEST judge\", overlay=true)\nif ta.crossover(ta.sma(close, 10), ta.sma(close, 30))\n    strategy.entry(\"L\", strategy.long)\nif ta.crossunder(ta.sma(close, 10), ta.sma(close, 30))\n    strategy.close(\"L\")\n", "bars": 500, "range": null, "versionSuffix": "AI TEST judge {{run.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-judge-bt"
      - id: done
        kind: poll
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "trades", "limit": 10}
        until:
          path: data.status
          oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"]
        intervalMs: 2000
        timeoutMs: 180000
      - id: shot
        kind: screenshot
        source: window
      - id: latest
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
      - id: delete
        type: backtesting.delete
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.latest.data.revision}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-judge-bt-delete"
    criteria:
      - The get response states the captured period, bar count and execution model, so the result is reproducible.
      - Trade rows carry entry/exit times, prices and P&L that are consistent with each other.
      - Metrics (net P&L, drawdown, win rate, fees) are present and plausible for a long-only SMA cross.
      - The UI or response does not imply real broker execution or exchange-verified fills.

  - id: llm.error-quality
    name: Error messages for common agent mistakes are actionable
    category: contract
    tags: ["llm", "errors"]
    judge: llm
    steps:
      - id: badDrawing
        type: drawings.create
        params: {"tool": "rectangle", "points": [{"time": 1717200000, "price": 100}]}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-judge-baddraw"
      - id: badPine
        type: indicators.validate
        params: {"source": "//@version=5\nindicator(\"AI TEST\")\nplot(ta.rsi(close))\n"}
      - id: badRun
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "sim-ai-test-missing"}
    criteria:
      - Each failure returns a stable machine code, not a generic COMMAND_FAILED where a specific code exists.
      - Each message says what was wrong and what to do next (e.g. point count, missing argument, unknown run).
      - No message leaks file paths, tokens, URLs or stack traces.

version: 1
suite:
  id: patterns
  name: Historical Patterns study
  description: Reads Patterns state, searches a symbol, configures a small Monday-open study on NSE 15m, runs it once and polls to completion. May consume provider quota; run only when explicitly requested.
  requires:
    grants: []
    signIn: true
  cost: consumes-provider-quota

tests:
  - id: patterns.state
    name: patterns.getState exposes revisions and job state
    category: contract
    tags: ["patterns"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: patterns.getState
      params: {}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.revision
          type: number
        - path: data.job
          exists: true
    teardown:
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}

  - id: patterns.search
    name: patterns.searchSymbols finds TCS
    category: contract
    tags: ["patterns"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: patterns.searchSymbols
      params: {"query": "TCS"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.symbols
          contains: {"ticker": "NSE:TCS-EQ"}
      state:
        - label: the read left the sidebar unchanged
          type: workspace.getState
          params: {}
          assertions:
            - path: data.sidebar
              equals: "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar}}"

  - id: patterns.monday-open
    name: Configure, run and poll a 20-week Monday 09:15-10:30 study
    category: workflow
    tags: ["patterns", "costly", "slow"]
    setup:
      - id: state
        type: patterns.getState
        params: {}
      - id: configure
        type: patterns.configure
        params: {"expectedRevision": "{{steps.state.data.revision}}", "query": {"symbol": "NSE:TCS-EQ", "resolution": "15", "weekdays": [1], "startMinute": 555, "endMinute": 630, "count": 20, "mode": "separate"}}
      - id: configured
        type: patterns.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: patterns.run
      params: {"expectedRevision": "{{steps.configured.data.revision}}"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.runId
          exists: true
      state:
        - label: job reaches a terminal state with the applied query
          kind: poll
          type: patterns.getResults
          params: {"runId": "{{steps.execute.data.runId}}", "offset": 0, "limit": 6}
          until:
            path: data.status
            oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
          intervalMs: 2000
          timeoutMs: 120000
          assertions:
            - path: data.status
              equals: completed
            - path: data.rows
              type: array

    category: contract
    tags: ["patterns", "errors"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
      - id: state
        type: patterns.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: patterns.configure
      params: {"expectedRevision": "{{steps.state.data.revision}}", "query": {"symbol": "NSE:TCS-EQ", "weekdays": [1], "startMinute": 0, "endMinute": 60, "count": 5, "mode": "separate"}}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
    teardown:
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}

files.tl-testing/suites/screening-read.yaml:
version: 1
suite:
  id: "screening-read"
  name: "Scanner and Patterns without quota"
  description: "Exercises Scanner and Historical Patterns commands that never execute a scan or study: view switching, draft revision guards, unknown run/history IDs and analysis on missing results. Opening the Scanner/Patterns is restored from the sidebar read in setup; the draft is re-applied unchanged. Consumes no scan allowance or provider quota."
  requires:
    grants: []
    signIn: true

tests:
  - id: scanread.show-history
    name: "screening.show switches to Scanned History without executing"
    category: state
    tags: ["screening", "ui"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
      - id: draft
        type: screening.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: screening.show
      params: {"view": "history"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: "ok"
        - path: data.view
          equals: "history"
        - path: data.executed
          equals: false
        - path: data.visible
          equals: true
      state:
        - label: "state reports the history view and the draft is unchanged"
          type: screening.getState
          params: {}
          assertions:
          - path: data.view
            equals: "history"
          - path: data.revision
            equals: "{{steps.draft.data.revision}}"
    teardown:
      - id: backToScanner
        type: screening.show
        params: {"view": "{{steps.draft.data.view}}"}
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}
      - id: sidebarRestored
        kind: poll
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
        until: {"path": "data.sidebar.panel", "equals": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}"}
        intervalMs: 500
        timeoutMs: 10000

  - id: scanread.show-invalid
    name: "screening.show rejects an unknown view"
    category: contract
    tags: ["screening", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: screening.show
      params: {"view": "bogus"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: "error"
        - path: code
          equals: "INVALID_PARAMS"

  - id: scanread.configure-stale

      type: screening.configure
      params: {"definition": {"mode": "preset", "preset": "gainers"}, "expectedRevision": -1}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: "error"
        - path: code
          equals: "INVALID_PARAMS"
      state:
        - label: "draft revision unchanged"
          type: screening.getState
          params: {}
          assertions:
          - path: data.revision
            equals: "{{steps.draft.data.revision}}"
    teardown:
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}
      - id: sidebarRestored

        params: {}

    assert:

files.tl-testing/suites/screening.yaml:
version: 1
suite:
  id: screening
  name: Cloud Scanner configure, run and read
  description: Reads Scanner state and catalog, configures a two-symbol custom definition, runs once, polls results and checks pagination. Consumes scan allowance; run only when explicitly requested.
  requires:
    grants: []
    signIn: true
  cost: consumes-scan-allowance

tests:
  - id: screening.read
    name: State, catalog and universes are readable
    category: contract
    tags: ["screening"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
      - id: catalog
        type: screening.catalog
        params: {}
      - id: universes
        type: screening.listUniverses
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: screening.getState
      params: {}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.revision
          type: number
        - path: data.storage
          type: string
    teardown:
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}

  - id: screening.custom-run
    name: Configure a custom two-symbol scan, run once, poll results
    category: workflow
    tags: ["screening", "costly", "slow"]
    setup:
      - id: state
        type: screening.getState
        params: {}
      - id: configure
        type: screening.configure
        params: {"expectedRevision": "{{steps.state.data.revision}}", "definition": {"mode": "custom", "timeframe": "1D", "lookback_days": 180, "limit": 10, "match": "all", "conditions": [{"field": "close", "op": "gt", "value": 0}]}, "universe": {"kind": "symbols", "tickers": ["NSE:TCS-EQ", "NSE:INFY-EQ"]}}
      - id: configured
        type: screening.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: screening.run
      params: {"expectedRevision": "{{steps.configured.data.revision}}"}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.runId
          exists: true
      state:
        - label: results reach a terminal state with at most two rows
          kind: poll
          type: screening.getResults
          params: {"runId": "{{steps.execute.data.runId}}", "offset": 0, "limit": 10}
          until:
            path: data.status
            oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
          intervalMs: 2000
          timeoutMs: 120000
          assertions:
            - path: data.status
              equals: completed
            - path: data.rows
              type: array

  - id: screening.stale-revision
    name: A stale draft revision is rejected and nothing runs
    category: contract
    tags: ["screening", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: screening.run
      params: {"expectedRevision": -1}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

  - id: screening.history
    name: Scan history pages are readable
    category: contract
    tags: ["screening"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
    execute:
      type: screening.listHistory
      params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 5}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.items
          type: array
        - path: data.pagination.total
          gte: 0
        - path: data.opensPanel
          equals: false
      state:
        - label: the read left the sidebar unchanged
          type: workspace.getState
          params: {}
          assertions:
            - path: data.sidebar
              equals: "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar}}"

version: 1
suite:
  id: smoke
  name: Read-only bridge smoke
  description: Discovery, tab readiness, permissions and core read-only command contracts. Safe on a user's real workspace; never mutates.

tests:

version: 1
suite:
  id: strategy-optimization
  name: Small Pine parameter grid
  description: Runs a frozen Pine backtest, previews and executes a 2x2 sweep over declared input IDs, polls the optimization section and checks the winner is one of the requested candidates. Deletes the AI TEST run afterwards.
  activeHistoryPolicy: |
    Inspect the history setup response before changing the chart or creating the base run.
    If data.runs has three active entries, reclaim ONLY a stopped run created by THIS
    invocation: its ID must be recorded from a successful creation and its name must start
    with AI TEST. Prefix matching alone does not establish ownership. Read backtesting.get,
    delete that ID using the fresh revision and an ai-test retry key, then verify absence
    with backtesting.list. Never delete or cancel unowned runs, including old AI TEST residue.
    Otherwise SKIP with reason SIMULATION_HISTORY_FULL: no safe active slot; export/save
    then explicitly Delete a stopped run in History. Do not run or optimize a user run.
    If run races with another creator and returns SIMULATION_HISTORY_FULL, apply this same
    rule or SKIP; teardown skips uncaptured IDs but still restores any changed chart.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentIndicators"]
    signIn: false
  defaults:
    strategy: |
      //@version=5
      strategy("AI TEST optimize", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000)
      fastLen = input.int(10, "Fast", minval=2)
      slowLen = input.int(30, "Slow", minval=3)
      if ta.crossover(ta.sma(close, fastLen), ta.sma(close, slowLen))
          strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
      if ta.crossunder(ta.sma(close, fastLen), ta.sma(close, slowLen))
          strategy.close("Long")

tests:
  - id: optimize.sweep
    name: Preview then run a 4-candidate sweep on a completed run
    category: workflow
    tags: ["optimization", "pine", "slow"]
    setup:
      - id: history
        type: backtesting.list
        params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 5}
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "NSE:INFY-EQ", "feed": "default", "interval": "1D"}
      - id: chartReady
        kind: poll
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.history.state
          equals: ready
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
      - id: run
        type: backtesting.run
        params: {"language": "pine", "source": "{{suite.defaults.strategy}}", "bars": 1000, "range": null, "versionSuffix": "AI TEST opt {{run.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-opt-run"
      - id: base
        kind: poll
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
        until:
          path: data.status
          oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"]
        intervalMs: 2000
        timeoutMs: 180000
      - id: preview
        type: backtesting.optimizePreview
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.base.data.revision}}", "mode": "sweep", "grid": {"fastLen": [5, 10], "slowLen": [20, 40]}, "objective": "netPnl"}
    execute:
      type: backtesting.optimize
      params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.base.data.revision}}", "mode": "sweep", "grid": {"fastLen": [5, 10], "slowLen": [20, 40]}, "objective": "netPnl"}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-opt-sweep"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      state:
        - label: optimization completes with all candidates evaluated
          kind: poll
          type: backtesting.get
          params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "optimization", "offset": 0, "limit": 10}
          until:
            path: data.research.status
            oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
          intervalMs: 2000
          timeoutMs: 240000
          assertions:
            - path: data.research.status
              equals: completed
            - path: data.research.total
              equals: 4
            - path: data.rows
              length: 4
    teardown:
      - id: latest
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
      - id: delete
        type: backtesting.delete
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.latest.data.revision}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-opt-delete"
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: optimize.preview-only-guard
    name: Preview refuses a nonexistent run without execution
    category: contract
    tags: ["optimization", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: backtesting.optimizePreview
      params: {"runId": "sim-ai-test-does-not-exist", "expectedRevision": 1, "mode": "sweep", "grid": {}}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error
        - path: code
          exists: true

  - id: optimize.holdout-needs-bars
    name: Holdout without trainBars/testBars is rejected
    category: contract
    tags: ["optimization", "errors"]
    execute:
      type: backtesting.optimizePreview
      params: {"runId": "sim-ai-test-does-not-exist", "expectedRevision": 1, "mode": "holdout", "grid": {"fastLen": [5, 10]}}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: error

suite:

  name: "Reversible UI preferences and chart navigation"
  description: "Exercises local UI commands that need no grant: theme round-trip (restored from the returned previous value), latest-history navigation and reload on the current chart (symbol/interval/live verified unchanged), research sidebar reopen (restored from setup), plus invalid-parameter paths. chart.setLive true is not sent (it starts a stream)."

  - id: ui.history-no-previous

suite:

files.tl-testing/suites/workflows.yaml:
version: 1
suite:
  id: workflows
  name: Multi-step end-to-end workflows
  description: Chains commands across domains the way a user would ask an agent - chart to alert, strategy to evidence, scan to grid - and cleans up everything it created.
  requires:
    grants: ["allowAgentWrites", "allowAgentIndicators"]
    signIn: true

tests:
  - id: workflow.chart-to-alert
    name: Open a chart, read the last close, set an alert 20% above it, then delete it
    category: workflow
    tags: ["workflow", "charts", "alerts", "cloud-write"]
    setup:
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "NSE:RELIANCE-EQ", "feed": "default", "interval": "1D"}
      - id: ready
        kind: poll
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.history.state
          equals: ready
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
      - id: snap
        type: chart.snapshot
        params: {"bars": 1}
    execute:
      type: alerts.create
      params: {"ticker": "NSE:RELIANCE-EQ", "price": "{{steps.snap.data.rows.0.4 * 1.2}}", "direction": "above", "name": "AI TEST wf {{run.id}}", "message": "AI TEST workflow alert", "expiresAt": "{{run.expiresIso}}"}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-alert"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.rule.ticker
          equals: NSE:RELIANCE-EQ
        - path: data.rule.id
          exists: true
    teardown:
      - id: delete
        type: alerts.delete
        params: {"id": "{{steps.execute.data.rule.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-alert-delete"
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: workflow.validate-backtest-evidence
    name: Validate a strategy, backtest it, read trades and capture the chart overlay
    category: workflow
    tags: ["workflow", "backtesting", "pine", "slow", "visual"]
    setup:
      - id: chartBefore
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
      - id: panelBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
      - id: open
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "NSE:TCS-EQ", "feed": "default", "interval": "1D"}
      - id: ready
        kind: poll
        type: chart.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.history.state
          equals: ready
        intervalMs: 1000
        timeoutMs: 30000
      - id: compile
        type: indicators.validate
        params: {"source": "//@version=5\nstrategy(\"AI TEST wf\", overlay=true)\nif ta.crossover(ta.ema(close, 8), ta.ema(close, 21))\n    strategy.entry(\"L\", strategy.long)\nif ta.crossunder(ta.ema(close, 8), ta.ema(close, 21))\n    strategy.close(\"L\")\n"}
      - id: run
        type: backtesting.run
        params: {"language": "pine", "source": "//@version=5\nstrategy(\"AI TEST wf\", overlay=true)\nif ta.crossover(ta.ema(close, 8), ta.ema(close, 21))\n    strategy.entry(\"L\", strategy.long)\nif ta.crossunder(ta.ema(close, 8), ta.ema(close, 21))\n    strategy.close(\"L\")\n", "bars": 750, "range": null, "versionSuffix": "AI TEST wf {{run.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-bt"
      - id: done
        kind: poll
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
        until:
          path: data.status
          oneOf: ["completed", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"]
        intervalMs: 2000
        timeoutMs: 180000
      - id: show
        type: backtesting.show
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-bt-show"
      - id: openPanel
        type: workspace.setPanel
        params: {"panel": "backtesting", "expanded": true}
      - id: panelVisible
        kind: poll
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
        until:
          path: data.panels.backtesting.visible
          equals: true
        intervalMs: 500
        timeoutMs: 10000
    execute:
      type: backtesting.get
      params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "section": "trades", "offset": 0, "limit": 5}
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
        - path: data.status
          equals: completed
        - path: data.metrics.equity
          finite: true
        - path: data.offset
          equals: 0
      visual:
        screenshot: workflow-backtest-overlay
        criteria:
          - Entry and exit markers from "AI TEST wf" appear on the TCS daily candles.
          - Marker placement looks consistent with EMA crossovers (no markers floating far from price).
          - The backtesting panel shows the run as completed with net P&L and drawdown values.
    teardown:
      - id: detach
        type: backtesting.removeFromChart
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-bt-detach"
      - id: latest
        type: backtesting.get
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "limit": 1}
      - id: delete
        type: backtesting.delete
        params: {"runId": "{{steps.run.data.runId}}", "expectedRevision": "{{steps.latest.data.revision}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-bt-delete"
      - id: restorePanel
        type: workspace.setPanel
        params: {"panel": "backtesting", "expanded": "{{steps.panelBefore.data.panels.backtesting.visible}}"}
      - id: restoreChart
        type: chart.open
        params: {"symbol": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.symbol}}", "feed": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.feed}}", "interval": "{{steps.chartBefore.data.interval}}"}

  - id: workflow.symbols-to-grid-to-watchlist
    name: Open a grid of explicit symbols, then save the same symbols as an AI TEST watchlist and remove it
    category: workflow
    tags: ["workflow", "grid", "watchlists", "cloud-write"]
    setup:
      - id: sidebarBefore
        type: workspace.getState
        params: {}
      - id: grid
        type: grid.open
        params: {"symbols": ["NSE:TCS-EQ", "NSE:INFY-EQ", "NSE:WIPRO-EQ"], "label": "AI TEST wf grid {{run.id}}"}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-grid"
      - id: gridState
        type: grid.getState
        params: {"offset": 0, "limit": 10}
    execute:
      type: watchlists.create
      params: {"name": "AI TEST wf {{run.id}}", "symbols": ["NSE:TCS-EQ", "NSE:INFY-EQ", "NSE:WIPRO-EQ"]}
      idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-wl"
    assert:
      response:
        - path: status
          equals: ok
      state:
        - label: watchlist exists with three symbols
          type: watchlists.list
          params: {}
          assertions:
            - path: data.watchlists
              contains: {"name": "AI TEST wf {{run.id}}", "count": 3}
    teardown:
      - id: deleteList
        type: watchlists.manage
        params: {"action": "delete", "name": "AI TEST wf {{run.id}}", "confirm": true}
        idempotencyKey: "ai-test-{{run.id}}-wf-wl-delete"
      - id: restoreSidebar
        type: workspace.openSidebar
        params: {"panel": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.panel}}", "expanded": "{{steps.sidebarBefore.data.sidebar.expanded}}"}

files.README.md:
# TradingLead skills

Canonical skill folders live here, not in the ContentLead skill repository.
Every skill uses the `tl-` prefix. This collection documents the **actual
TradingLead Desktop command surface**, including bounded, human-approved native
UI input and tab recording on supported Desktop versions, not unrestricted
desktop automation.

| Group | Skill | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start | [tl-desktop](tl-desktop/SKILL.md) | Connection, tab targeting, permissions, retries, native clicks/right-clicks, hover/scroll/type/keys, tab recording, workspace shell and the full UI map |
| Charting | [tl-charts](tl-charts/SKILL.md) | Chart/feed navigation, history, snapshots, native replay, view/scale/range/timezone/legend, Compare, toolbar actions and screenshots, native studies and indicator templates, drawings, drawing templates, split layouts, pane targeting and linking, saved chart layouts, Chart Grid |
| Markets | [tl-markets](tl-markets/SKILL.md) | Watchlists (Watch grid, select/sort/filter/columns, CSV text, order, flags, favorites, create/add/remove/rename/delete), Multi Watchlists, symbol details, peers and refresh, indices, heatmap, Market Intelligence, Futures, universes, raw candles |
| Alerts | [tl-alerts](tl-alerts/SKILL.md) | Saved price alerts: list, create, edit (incl. message/expiry), pause/resume, delete, trigger activity and monitoring semantics |
| Analysis | [tl-screening](tl-screening/SKILL.md) | Unified Scanner, original strategies/SQL, grid analysis and refinement, Scanned History, saved rules, provider scans, Grid/watchlist handoff |
| Analysis | [tl-patterns](tl-patterns/SKILL.md) | Historical weekday/IST-window studies, coverage, filtered statistics and dated occurrence navigation |
| Analysis | [tl-research](tl-research/SKILL.md) | Saved HTML research pages in the right sidebar |
| Authoring | [tl-tlscript](tl-tlscript/SKILL.md) | TLScript-Pine indicator authoring, isolated validation, current saved revisions and named chart settings |
| Authoring | [tl-python](tl-python/SKILL.md) | Isolated Python authoring, syntax validation, source history and named chart settings |
| Strategy | [tl-backtesting](tl-backtesting/SKILL.md) | Python/Pine strategy backtests, applied strategies, saved runs, presets and chart overlays |
| Strategy | [tl-strategy-optimization](tl-strategy-optimization/SKILL.md) | Strategy Optimizer: parameter sweeps, holdout, walk-forward and detailed offline HTML reports |
| Strategy | [tl-paper-trading](tl-paper-trading/SKILL.md) | Direct replay-to-trade practice, backtest-derived replay, forward paper and simulated orders |
| Strategy | [tl-strategy-research](tl-strategy-research/SKILL.md) | Deprecated compatibility router to tl-strategy-optimization (no procedure ownership) |
| Quality | [tl-testing](tl-testing/SKILL.md) | Agent-run testing of TradingLead Desktop: YAML suites of real bridge commands with response/state/visual assertions, isolation and cleanup, reporting, plus the local unit-test commands (owns no commands) |

## Choose one workflow owner

These are product-use guides, not separate execution engines. Start with
`tl-desktop` for connection and access, then select the skill for the requested
outcome. Load a companion only when that part of the task is needed.

| Outcome | Primary skill | Add only when needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open/switch a panel, theme, or find which skill owns a UI area | `tl-desktop` | The owner from its UI map |
| Click/right-click, hover, scroll, type, navigate with keys or record the chart tab | `tl-desktop` ([native input](tl-desktop/ui-automation.md)) | Domain skill for result verification; Desktop 0.1.9+ and human approval required |
| Open a symbol, change interval/feed, browse history, replay candles | `tl-charts` | `tl-markets` to pick a symbol from a watchlist |
| Change chart type, scale, range, timezone; compare symbols; screenshot | `tl-charts` | — |
| Draw, hide, lock or remove chart drawings; reorder favorite drawing tools | `tl-charts` ([drawings](tl-charts/drawings.md)) | — |
| Save/apply native indicator templates | `tl-charts` | — |
| Split the chart, link panes, work on another pane, save/load chart layouts | `tl-charts` ([layouts-grid](tl-charts/layouts-grid.md)) | — |
| Show many tickers as chart cards (Chart Grid) | `tl-charts` ([layouts-grid](tl-charts/layouts-grid.md)) | `tl-screening` for a scan run or selected rows |
| Read/sort/filter/export a watchlist, reorder/flag/star, manage membership | `tl-markets` | `tl-screening` to source symbols from a scan |
| Company details, peers, indices, heatmap, Intelligence, Futures, raw candles | `tl-markets` | `tl-charts` to open the symbol first |
| Create, edit, pause or review saved price alerts | `tl-alerts` | `tl-charts` for trendline alerts drawn by a person |
| Screen many stocks | `tl-screening` | `tl-research` to report existing results without rerunning |
| Review one ticker's historical weekday/time windows | `tl-patterns` | `tl-charts` for requested feed/chart changes; `tl-research` to report existing results |
| Write or revise a chart indicator | `tl-tlscript` or `tl-python` | `tl-charts` for chart/feed work |
| Run or explain a Python/Pine strategy backtest | `tl-backtesting` | `tl-python` for Python source/SDK authoring; `tl-tlscript` for Pine language-support discovery, not strategy execution |
| Sweep parameters or evaluate holdout/walk-forward | `tl-strategy-optimization` | `tl-backtesting` to create/restore the prerequisite completed run |
| Trade a replay cursor or manage forward paper | `tl-paper-trading` | `tl-backtesting` for a backtest-derived branch or saved-run management; direct practice needs no strategy run |
| Publish an HTML explanation of existing results | `tl-research` | The result's workflow owner for evidence; reporting does not rerun or optimize a strategy |
| Test TradingLead itself (run smoke/domain suites, judge results, run unit tests) | `tl-testing` | The domain owner's guide when a failure needs diagnosis |

Authoring source, running a backtest, evaluating robustness and trading paper
are separate outcomes. A valid indicator is not a tested strategy; a completed
backtest is not out-of-sample evidence or real-broker execution. Python and Pine
do not have identical feature coverage: discover the requested workflow and
language before promising support. Repository maintenance is not required to
use an already-supported command.

## Install and discover

Desktop builds containing managed AI integration bundle these public skills and
the `tradinglead` CLI. Enable setup on first launch or through **Help > AI
integrations**; then open a new terminal and run `tradinglead agent-guide`.
No MCP, repository checkout or separate Node.js is required. Copilot registrations
are small app-owned loaders which read the currently selected compatible bundle,
not stale copies of the workflow. Conflicting user-owned registrations are
preserved and reported, not overwritten.

### Compatible app-managed releases

`bundle-policy.json` declares the monotonically increasing documentation revision,
inclusive minimum Desktop version, exclusive maximum version, CLI API and bridge
protocol. Change those requirements when instructions need new native behavior.
Keep the old compatible releases in the index: older apps select the newest
matching release, not simply the newest GitHub commit. Source changes alone are
not distributed until a bundle release is prepared and published.

After updating the public guides and validating their command references:

```bash
node validate.cjs
node --test tools.test.cjs bundle.test.cjs
node bundle.cjs --release
```

The last command generates immutable `bundle-N.json` and updates
`distribution.json` locally. Review and explicitly commit/publish both together
when authorized. Increase `revision` before changing a previously released bundle.
Do not add private guides or executable files. No GitHub Actions are required.

Desktop reads only this repository's fixed HTTPS distribution endpoint, verifies
the SHA-256 from the index, validates the document-only bundle and compatibility
requirements, then atomically switches its active pointer. Failed/offline updates
retain the last working version; damaged/incompatible caches fall back to the
packaged bundle with a visible warning. Hashes provide integrity, not a separate
publisher signature: repository access and GitHub HTTPS are the trust boundary.
Automatic checks are at most daily on app launch while integration is enabled.

The cloud frontend can change independently. A compatible bundle is **not**
certification of every command on every tab: discover live capabilities and
domain readiness before execution. Never use a missing command/parameter,
substitute another tab/feed or bypass permissions to follow an example.

### Manual developer installation

Clone the public collection, then install with Node.js 18+:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Shubham-vish/tradinglead-skills.git
cd tradinglead-skills
node install.cjs
node install.cjs --check
node validate.cjs
```

Installing the skills does not install TradingLead Desktop. Running the documented
app commands requires Desktop and access to its CLI; refreshing references expects
the sibling checkout described below.

The installer creates one link per skill in `~/.copilot/skills/` pointing here.
It uses directory junctions on Windows and directory symlinks on macOS/Linux.
It refuses to overwrite a conflicting folder or link; no existing ContentLead
or personal skills are moved. The source of truth remains this folder.

In Copilot CLI, run **`/skills reload`** or start a new session, then
`/skills info tl-desktop`. Filesystem verification is not a claim that an
already-running agent has refreshed its in-memory skill list.

Official discovery documentation:
https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/customize-copilot/add-skills

## Command coverage

See [COMMANDS.md](COMMANDS.md) for every advertised command and its owning skill.
Each skill's `commands.md` contains exact descriptions, parameter names and
retry requirements generated from the checked frontend source catalog. `command-catalog.json`
is a documentation snapshot, **not** a substitute for fresh app capabilities.

The current snapshot has **242 frontend descriptors** (193 canonical commands
plus 49 compatibility aliases) and 6 native Desktop controls, about 110 KiB of
catalog JSON. Owned descriptors per skill, including aliases: tl-desktop 5,
tl-charts 32, tl-markets 20, tl-alerts 6, tl-screening 27, tl-patterns 11,
tl-research 7, tl-tlscript 24, tl-python 16, tl-backtesting 58,
tl-strategy-optimization 12, tl-paper-trading 24, tl-strategy-research 0
(the backtesting, optimization and paper totals include `simulation.*` and
legacy optimization aliases). Exact ownership is generated in
[COMMANDS.md](COMMANDS.md).
This is a snapshot of a development frontend, not evidence that another tab or
the released app has the same contracts. Updated Desktop source accepts up to 256 commands and 128 KiB
of catalog JSON; older packaged bridges accept at most 180 / 56 KiB. Ship
the Desktop bridge update before a frontend catalog that exceeds the older
limit, or the older bridge may reject the entire catalog. The command transport
remains capped at 2 MiB, with smaller domain budgets and pagination.

Coverage uses frontend catalog/validation, isolated command/native-chart
fixtures and read-only capability discovery. The snapshot retains its
**isolated-source** generation provenance. On October 29, 2026 a ready
production-origin tab in installed Desktop 0.1.6 advertised the same 211
descriptors as the then-current snapshot. This was read-only discovery, not
execution of all handlers. Later discovery returned no trusted tabs; the audit
did not restart, reload or switch the running app.
Subsequent local descriptor/runtime corrections, native retry fixes and the 28
workspace-UI commands (chart view/compare/actions, drawings, layouts, Chart
Grid, Watch/market panels, alert edit/activity, sidebar and theme) are
source/test verified only; the current snapshot was regenerated from the
isolated frontend source registry because no Desktop tab was ready.
It does **not** certify user charts, broker credentials, cloud-library writes or the
deployed website. Source, an installed Desktop tab and cloud availability can
differ; `status:"ok"` for catalog discovery is not chart/data readiness.

`node validate.cjs` checks every skill's generated contract and all supporting
Markdown guides, including nested guides: example command ownership, parameter
names, retry keys, local links and reachability from this index. It does not
execute examples or validate runtime-specific parameter values. Run
`node sync-commands.cjs --tab ACTUAL_TAB_ID --check` separately for live parity.
It also parses every `tl-testing/suites/*.yaml` (dependency-free YAML subset in
`suites.cjs`) and rejects steps with unknown command types, unknown or missing
required parameters, missing retry keys on mutating steps, mutations in
read-only suites, and references to undefined earlier steps.

### Real boundaries

| Surface | Current agent support |
| --- | --- |
| TLScript-Pine/Python source libraries and applied studies | Pine current revision only; Python retained source history; isolated syntax/compile validation and named appearance read/write |
| Typed calculation inputs | Open the dialog with `showInputs`; user Apply is explicit. Programmatic parameter changes use apply/update. |
| Indicator named appearance | Both namespaces support stable instance IDs or primary entity IDs, current/default snapshots and stale-protected style/visibility resets. No generic setter for arbitrary TradingView studies. |
| Pine `strategy()` | `backtesting.run` with `language:"pine"`; vectorized only, rejected on indicator/scanner surfaces, no live orders |
| Applied strategy | `backtesting.applyStrategy/appliedStrategy/removeStrategy/setStrategyAutoRerun`; one chart strategy at a time |
| Chart replay paper practice | `backtesting.practice` starts directly at a paused chart replay cursor without a completed strategy backtest |
| Native manual Bar Replay | `chart.replayControl` requests selection/play/pause/step/speed/end. Select still requires the user to pick a candle; paper replay is separate. |
| Built-in studies and user drawings | `studies.applied/setVisibility/remove` target exact unmanaged native studies. `drawings.*` lists/creates/hides/locks/removes user drawings, sets toolbar modes, reorders favorite drawing tools and confirms remove-all; `drawingTemplates.*` restyle one selected drawing (library writes UI-only). `studyTemplates.manage` lists/saves/applies/deletes native indicator templates. |
| Chart view, Compare and toolbar | `chart.viewState/setView/compare/action`: type, scale, range, go-to-date, timezone, OHLC legend values, Compare/Overlay, undo/redo, dialogs, fullscreen and a bounded screenshot thumbnail. Dialogs still need a person to finish them; legend collapse and favorite-tool membership have no public API. |
| Split layouts and Chart Grid | `layout.*` selects the active pane every chart command targets and saves/loads chart layouts; and links symbol/interval from the active pane; `grid.*` opens (explicit symbols or all/filtered/selected scan rows) and configures the cloud-backed Chart Grid incl. theme, width, expand, chart indicators and open page. Crosshair sync is impossible; saved-layout rename/delete and the card enlarge dialog remain UI-only. |
| Watchlists and market panels | `watchlists.*` (incl. CSV text, manual order, flags, favorite stars), `symbol.details`, `peers.get/configure`, `indices.getState`, `heatmap.*`, `intelligence.*`, `futures.getReport` read/drive mounted panels. Not bulk quotes, live positions, live fundamentals or file/clipboard export; heatmap has no historical periods. |
| Saved price alerts | `alerts.*` lists/creates/edits/pauses/deletes rules and pages persisted trigger events; optional `message`/`expiresAt` need an Alerts API update that is not yet deployed (production rejects them until then); trendline geometry is UI-only; monitoring and expiry require the signed-in Alerts panel to remain mounted |
| Backtest overlays, styles and date selection | `backtesting.getChartOptions` / `backtesting.setChartOptions`; display changes do not rerun strategies |
| Presets and larger saved result history | Python-only reusable presets; separate saved-run library/import/export commands, with their own revisions |
| Strategy Optimizer: Optimize tab | Python and authoritative Pine frozen-data sweeps/holdout/walk-forward through `backtesting.optimize*`, distinct from HTML reports. Pine needs no Python runtime; rediscover installed availability first. |
| HTML research pages | Full `research.*` create/list/get/update/delete/show workflow |
| Unified Scanner and results analysis | `screening.*` supports original strategies, presets/custom/SQL, real-grid filters/sort/selection/expansion, exact-stock refinement and independent scan history |
| Shared authoring Docs, local backup import/export, Studio docking | UI features; no dedicated registered command for every control |
| Guided Practice Labs, account sign-in, membership/purchases, broker connect, Feedback send, product Tour, permission approval, administration and data-repair operations | Intentionally human/admin/operational surfaces, not missing public command namespaces |
| Broker credentials, arbitrary JavaScript, real broker orders | Not exposed by these product commands |

Do not look for a diagnostic script bridge as a substitute for missing
product commands: the dev-only diag bridge no longer has `/js` or `/devtools`.
Use `desktop screenshot`, `desktop logs`, `desktop services` and `desktop appInfo`. Explain unsupported automation honestly.

Local source implementation, the currently loaded frontend, and a released
cloud/packaged app are different states. Check the addressed tab's catalog
before relying on a feature; this collection does not deploy either app.

## Refresh the references

Keep `TradingLead-Desktop` alongside this folder, or supply its CLI path:

```bash
node ../TradingLead-Desktop/cli.cjs tabs
node sync-commands.cjs --tab ACTUAL_TAB_ID
# Alternate checkout:
node sync-commands.cjs --tab ACTUAL_TAB_ID --cli /path/to/TradingLead-Desktop/cli.cjs
node validate.cjs
# Read-only live parity check; fails on descriptor/parameter/reference drift:
node sync-commands.cjs --tab ACTUAL_TAB_ID --check
# No ready tab: regenerate/check from a JSON array of descriptors exported from
# the frontend source registry (recorded as source:"isolated-source", not live):
node sync-commands.cjs --catalog exported-commands.json
node sync-commands.cjs --catalog exported-commands.json --check
```

Refresh only from the intended trusted tab. The generator calls authenticated,
read-only CLI discovery and never records credentials, account IDs, saved
reports, source libraries or run data. Unknown commands fail ownership mapping
instead of being silently omitted. Review changed contracts and update the
workflow prose and examples when refreshing.
`validate.cjs` checks snapshot consistency only and labels its result accordingly;
it cannot detect new app commands by itself. Use the separate live `--check`
before claiming the collection matches an addressed tab. Neither check grants
access, executes source, or proves chart/data readiness.

Live parity compares the command contract, not snapshot provenance or JSON
object-key ordering; it still rejects changed descriptions, parameters, grants
and mutation flags, and checks generated references against the saved snapshot.
For local tooling regression checks, run `node --test tools.test.cjs`.
